## Review attestation
- Verdict: SHIP
- Reviewed-Commit: 9edbfd763453969f34f45f2ae5217819ca766082
- Reviewer 1 (Opus 5.5): fresh-context subagent (Step 2), 7 pass(es), SHIP
- Reviewer 2 (Fable): fresh-context subagent (Step 2), 3 pass(es), SHIP
- Findings:
  - finding 1: negated ages built the inverse → fixed (every negated age fails; owner-approved ADR 0039 amendment)
  - finding 2: gender negation list missed "exclude", "but", "n't" → fixed (shared negation list)
  - finding 3: family history matched only "family history" in details → fixed (wider match over term and details)
  - finding 4: shape check compared numbers, not whole years → fixed
  - finding 5: two surviving mutations → fixed (equal-bound and plural tests)
  - finding 6: implicit string concatenation → fixed
  - finding 7: n't missed the curly apostrophe and "cannot" → fixed
  - finding 8: more off-script denylist variants → fixed (lists extended); allowlist follow-up routed to #517
  - finding 9: symbol negations ("!= male") build the inverse gender → routed to #517
  - finding 10: family-history variants ("FamilyMemberHistory", "FHx") → routed to #517
  - finding 11: "exclusively" read as a negation → fixed
  - finding 12: "under 18 or 65 and over" drops 65-year-olds (the single-bound misreading) → routed to #431
  - finding 13: three surviving mutations → fixed (tests added)
  - finding 14: some plausible two-bound phrasings fail rather than build → accepted (fail-safe, per ADR 0039)
  - finding 15: the "exclusive" exemption let "exclusive of males" build male → fixed (only "exclusively" is exempt)
  - process: reviewer 1's pass 6 overlapped reviewer 2's mutation in the shared worktree → settled; reviewer 1's pass 7 re-ran the pass-6 checks on a tree whose sha256 matched HEAD, with no mutations, and all results reproduced
